The Hindu article on the Integrated Government Complex (dt. 27th April, 2025)

5/22/25, 5:35 AM Iconic Integrated Amaravati Government Complex with five towers to come up in 32 acres - The Hindu

## Iconic Integrated Amaravati
Government Complex with five
towers to come up in 32 acres

The towers will house the General Administration Department, the Andhra
Pradesh State Secretariat, and HoD offices; tenders have already been called for
their construction in three packages

Updated - April 27, 2025 09:19 pm IST - AMARAVATI

SAMBASIVA RAO M.



*ఈ చిత్రం ఒక భవిష్యత్ పట్టణ దృశ్యాన్ని చూపుతుంది. ఇందులో ఎత్తైన, సన్నని భవనాలు మరియు నీటి ప్రవాహాలు ఉన్నాయి. భవనాలు ఆధునిక నిర్మాణ శైలిని కలిగి ఉన్నాయి, మరియు ప్రకృతి దృశ్యంలో పచ్చని చెట్లు ఉన్నాయి. ఈ చిత్రం ఒక ఊహాత్మక లేదా డిజిటల్ రెండరింగ్ లాగా కనిపిస్తుంది.*

Prime Minister Narendra Modi will relaunch the works on construction of the capital city

The five towers will house the General Administration Department (GAD), the Andhra Pradesh State Secretariat, and the Head of
Department (HoD) offices.

The Andhra Pradesh Capital Region Development Authority (APCRDA) has already Invited tenders In three packages for construction of
the dive towers.

It is estimated that the GAD tower costs ₹844 crore. While the cost of towers 1 and 2 is put at ₹1,423 crore, the cost of towers 3 and 4 is
estimated to be ₹1,247 crore.

These buildings are designed in a way that the HoD offices and the Secretariat (around 145 departments) co-exist to bring efficiency in
their functioning. They will have office spaces, a variety of amenities and basement parking.

The proposed Secretariat and HoD buildings will have sufficient office spaces (chambers, open offices etc.), conference facilities, podiums,
and common amenities for the staff.

According to the documents provided by the APCRDA, four towers will have Basement + Ground + 39 floors, while the GAD tower, the
tallest on the southwest, will have B + G + 49 floors. The total site area is 32 acres. Each floor has a built-up area of 2,209 sq. m and carpet
or floor area of 1,200 sq. m. The towers together will have a built-up area of approximately 4,85,000 sq. m.

The Hindu article reports
Government’s estimations as follows,

GAD Tower – Rs. 844 cr.
Tower 1 & 2 – Rs.1,423 cr.
Tower 3 & 4 – Rs. 1,247 cr.

Note – The integrated Amarvati
Government Complex would be
constructed in an area of

4,85,000 sq.m.
(52,20,497 sq.ft)

The estimated cost is Rs. 3,514 crores.

Contract awarded for value – Rs. 3,673
crores (4.54% escalation over ECV).

Monetary value of reimbursable is – Rs.
681 crores.

Administrative sanction for MEP works –
Rs. 2,316 cr. (Source – GO RT 316 dt.
16/03/2026)

Administrative sanction for Government
complex infra works – Rs. 1,053 cr.
(Source – GO RT 628 dt. 26/06/2025)

Total cost – 7,723.1 crores

Cost per sq.ft – Rs. 14,795

[^1]: An artist's impression of the proposed five towers designed by the APCRDA at Palavagu in Amaravati.

## Extracts from GOs providing administrative sanctions for expenditure on Govt. complex

## GOVERNMENT OF ANDHRA PRADESH
ABSTRACT

Municipal Administration & Urban Development (CRDA) Department –
Administrative Sanction for an amount of Rs.1,052.67 Crores (Rupees
One Thousand Fifty-Two Crores and Sixty-Seven Lakhs Only) towards the
work “Construction of Roads, Drains, Water Supply, Sewerage, Utility
Ducts for Power & ICT, Reuse Water Line, and Avenue Plantation
compatible with trunk infrastructure in layouts for the Amaravati
Government Complex area in Amaravati Capital City, Andhra Pradesh –
Orders – Issued.

## MUNICIPAL ADMINISTRATION & URBAN DEVELOPMENT (CRDA) DEPARTMENT

G.O.RT.No. 628

Dated: 26-06-2025
Read the following:-

1. Resolution No.554/2025 of 49th APCRDA Authority Meeting,
Dt.13.06.2025.

2. From the Commissioner, APCRDA, Vijayawada, Lr.No.MAU61-
COOR0MEET(CM)/4/2025-OM, Dt.20.06.2025.

## ***

## ORDER:-

In the reference 2ⁿᵈ read above, the Commissioner, Andhra Pradesh
Capital Region Development Authority, Vijayawada has informed that, the
49ᵗʰ APCRDA Authority Meeting held on 13ᵗʰ June, 2025, passed the
following resolution on the agenda item and furnished to the Government
for necessary approval.

2. After careful examination, the Government hereby accords
Administrative Sanction for an amount of Rs.1,052.67 Crores (Rupees
One Thousand Fifty-Two Crores and Sixty-Seven Lakhs Only) towards the
work “Construction of Roads, Drains, Water Supply, Sewerage, Utility
Ducts for Power & ICT, Reuse Water Line, and Avenue Plantation
compatible with trunk infrastructure in layouts for the Amaravati
Government Complex area in Amaravati Capital City, Andhra Pradesh”.
The work shall be executed on a Lump Sum Contract (% Percentage
Tender) basis, including a Defect Liability Period (DLP) of 2 years and
Operations & Maintenance (O&M) for 7 years. Permission is also accorded
to invite tenders under the Lump Sum Contract (% Percentage Tender)
system, duly closing the previous agreement.

3. The Commissioner, Andhra Pradesh Capital Region Development Authority, Vijayawada shall take further necessary action, accordingly.

4. This order issues with the Concurrence of the Finance Department
vide their U.O.No.FIN01-FMU0MISC/325/2025, Dt.23.06.2025
(C.No.2874963).

## GOVERNMENT OF ANDHRA PRADESH
ABSTRACT

Municipal Administration & Urban Development (CRDA) Department –
Administrative sanction for an amount of Rs.2316.88 Crores towards the
MEP works of “ High side Electrical, HVAC, Fire Protection System, Lifts,
Fire Alarm & Public Address System and Plumbing works in Integrated
Andhra Pradesh State Secretariat & HoD Offices (GAD Tower, Towers 3 & 4
and Towers 1 & 2) in Amaravati Government Complex, Andhra Pradesh”-
Orders – Issued.

MUNICIPAL ADMINISTRATION & URBAN DEVELOPMENT (CRDA) DEPARTMENT

## G.O.Rt.No.316

Dated:16.03.2026
Read the following:-

1. Resolution No.638/2026 of 59th APCRDA Authority Meeting,
Dt.10.03.2026.

2. From the Commissioner, APCRDA, Vijayawada, Lr.No.MAU61-
COOR0MEET(CM)/2/2026-OM, Dt.10.03.2026.

## ***

## ORDER:-

In the reference 2nd read above, the Commissioner, Andhra Pradesh
Capital Region Development Authority, Vijayawada has informed that, the
59th APCRDA Authority Meeting held on 10.03.2026, passed the following
resolution on the agenda item and furnished to the Government for
necessary approval.

2. After careful examination, the Government hereby accords
administrative sanction for an amount of Rs.2316.88 Crores towards the
MEP works of “ High side Electrical, HVAC, Fire Protection System, Lifts,
Fire Alarm & Public Address System and Plumbing works in Integrated
Andhra Pradesh State Secretariat & HoD Offices (GAD Tower, Towers 3 & 4
and Towers 1 & 2) in Amaravati Government Complex, Andhra Pradesh”.

3. Further, the Government hereby permit the Managing Director,
Amaravati Growth and Infrastructure Corporation Limited (AGICL),
Vijayawada, to call for tenders under the Design & Build Lumpsum (%
Percentage Tender) Contract System and to take necessary action to
implement the decision of the Authority.

4. The Commissioner, Andhra Pradesh Capital Region Development Authority, Vijayawada / Managing Director, Amaravati Growth and Infrastructure Corporation Limited (AGICL), Vijayawada shall take further necessary action, accordingly.

(BY ORDER AND IN THE NAME OF THE GOVERNOR OF ANDHRA PRADESH)
(BY ORDER AND IN THE NAME OF THE GOVERNOR OF ANDHRA PRADESH)
S SURESH KUMAR
PRINCIPAL SECRETARY TO GOVERNMENT
S SURESH KUMAR
PRINCIPAL SECRETARYTO GOVERNMENT
—
